summary.headline: The Four Orbital Bands
summary.text: Discussion of the four conventional bands in eccentric and epicyclic orbits, contrasting divisions by distance with divisions by motion. It identifies band origins with apogee, perigee, visible apogee and perigee, and intermediate intersections or tangencies for the Moon, Mercury, Venus, and the superior planets.
